gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-cascadia-code: Spaghetti-thin, loud lettering: Funnel Display strokes all match in width, while Cascadia Code spaces its wire-like monoline characters far apart. Over pages, the plain sans body lets the eye glide around every bend.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-roundo: One-nib swagger, cut open at the ends: that's Gabarito. Roundo, a sans with an n whose arch and stem match, keeps every small counter unclogged, and that clarity is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-special-gothic: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open. Below, Special Gothic's rounded plain sans letters stay open and inviting, so text moves along approachably from one line to the next.
gen-gf-gajraj-one-fs-karma: Karma lets its terminals finish away from the stem and its modulation hush along, while Gajraj One piles on fat black stems. Gajraj One earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-alpino: Cozy and casual, the sans-serif body keeps its curve endings well apart; Goldman above it stretches wide, bold letters. Alpino probably wants a size a notch above usual, since its tall build makes ascenders look short.
gen-gf-grandstander-instrument-sans: Grandstander draws bold, constant-width lines with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Instrument Sans then keeps a steady stroke with open pincer-like c ends, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads soft and approachable, with tall bowls like blown glass bulbs, under Gugi's bold, distinctive headings. Lines of text glide by on stems and bars all alike in thickness.
gen-gf-halant-work-sans: Halant is refined and literary, its small letters nearly capital height. Work Sans supplies uniform, spaghetti-like strokes beneath, so the slight weight shifts in the serif above stand out against it.
gen-gf-kosugi-maru-fs-literata: Literata brings a bookish serif with sturdy, slightly heavier thick strokes. Kosugi Maru leads with drafting-pen outlines of one constant width, a friendly, open start before the serif text takes over.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-montserrat: Libertinus Mono has tall little letters, like pen-nib bowls pressed flat. It gives structure and precision, while Montserrat glides under the eye with generous white space leading into each curve.
